name: Coking Coal
notes: Origin-dependent. Australian HCC ~1.20-1.25. Typical: weight-limited in all vessel classes.

name: Thermal Coal
notes: Origin-dependent. Indonesian sub-bituminous ~1.35-1.45 (lower density). Usually weight-limited.

name: Iron Ore
notes: Emphatically weight-limited. High density. Fines have liquefaction risk - IMSBC Group A.

name: Iron Ore Pellets
notes: Pellets: higher angle of repose than fines. Still weight-limited. No liquefaction risk.

name: Limestone
notes: Weight-limited. Used in steel production (flux). Density varies by origin.

name: Bauxite
notes: Some bauxite grades have liquefaction risk. Check moisture content. Usually weight-limited.

name: Fertiliser
notes: Wide stowage factor range. Some grades (granular urea ~1.30) weight-limited; others volume-limited. Check cargo-specific SF.
